post.description:
Discover projects before fetching one with get_project. Use list_categories for category ids and search_locations for woe_ids.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description:
Numeric category id from list_categories or a card's `category.id` (e.g. 34 = Tabletop Games, 12 = Games).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from a previous page (`seed:page`). Mutually exclusive with `page` and `seed`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}:[0-9]{1,3}$.

goal.description:
Goal bucket 0..5 as on the discover page (0 = under $1,000 ... 5 = over $100,000).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 5.

page.description:
1-based page; 12 cards per page. Kickstarter answers 404 past roughly page 200.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

raised.description:
Funding bucket: 0 = under 75% funded, 1 = 75%-100%, 2 = over 100%.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 2.

recommended.description: Only projects Kickstarter marks as recommended.

seed.description:
Shuffle seed returned by a previous page; keeps `magic` order stable while paginating.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

sort.description:
Kickstarter sort. `magic` is a seeded shuffle: pass the returned `seed` (or `cursor`) to keep the order across pages.

Provider reference: allowed values ["magic", "newest", "popularity", "most_funded", "end_date", "most_backed"]; default "magic".

state.description:
Limit to live campaigns or to successfully funded ones. Omit for Kickstarter's default mix.

Provider reference: allowed values ["live", "successful"].

tag.description: Browse a tag collection (/discover/tags/{tag}, e.g. `witchstarter`, `make-100`; slugs from list_categories.tags). Combines with `sort` and `page` only. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,80}$.

woe_id.description:
Location WOE id from search_locations (e.g. 2357536 = Austin, TX).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search or browse Kickstarter projects through the public discover catalogue (GET /discover/advanced?format=json, or /discover/tags/{tag}?format=json when `tag` is given): free text, category, location (woe_id), state, staff picks, funding and goal buckets, six sorts; 12 project cards per page with funding progress (goal, pledged, percent_funded, backers_count, deadline), creator, category and location. `magic` sort is a seeded shuffle: the first page returns `seed`, pass it (or `next_cursor`) to keep pages consistent. An unknown term yields `total_hits: 0` and an empty `projects` array.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Number of cards in this response. |
| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `next_cursor` | string | `seed:next_page` for the next call, null when exhausted. |
| `next_page` | number | Next page number while `has_more`, else null. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when this result was fetched. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `projects` | object[] | Project cards in the order Kickstarter returned them. |
| `query` | object | The query as sent, after defaults. |
| `ref_tag` | string |  |
| `request_url` | string | The discover URL fetched. |
| `search_url` | string | Kickstarter's own relative discover URL for this query. |
| `seed` | number | Shuffle seed Kickstarter used; pass it back as `seed` (or use `next_cursor`). |
| `term_categories` | object[] | Categories Kickstarter associates with a free-text term (empty for browse queries). |
| `total_hits` | number | Kickstarter's total match count for the query. |

200.description:
Kickstarter search-box suggestions (GET /projects/search.json?term=): the project cards Kickstarter proposes for a typed term, in every state (live, successful, canceled, ...), in one response without pagination. Same card shape as search_projects. The suggestion endpoint takes only a term and has no page or cursor: has_more and total_hits only say the term matches more projects than the suggestion box shows. To see them, call search_projects with the same term and page through it (page, next_cursor).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Number of cards in this response. |
| `has_more` | boolean | Kickstarter's own flag that the term matches more projects than the suggestion set returned here. This endpoint cannot be paged: use search_projects with the same term (page / next_cursor) to retrieve the rest, or add words to the term to narrow the suggestions. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when this result was fetched. |
| `projects` | object[] | Project cards in the order Kickstarter returned them. |
| `ref_tag` | string |  |
| `search_url` | string | Kickstarter's own relative discover URL for this query. |
| `term` | string |  |
| `term_categories` | object[] |  |
